13. Beyond the Meme: What It Says About Us
At its core, the meme coin philosophy reveals how much of economics is a human construct. Whether it’s gold, fiat, or Dogecoin, value is ultimately what we agree it to be. Meme coins just stripped away the pretense.

8. Meme coins capitalized on this, becoming financialized representations of cultural virality.

Compare Dogecoin’s trajectory to Tesla stock: both traded not just on fundamentals but on narratives.
